title: [finding] `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs:28` still carries the dead `objectui#6741` citation that PR #18608 removed from two sibling files — and it is the header both corrected sites point readers to
body:
Split out of PR **#18608**'s patch round (report `5712468641`) rather than folded in: the seat's REWORK verdict scoped that round to the two files already in the diff, and `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` is not one of them. ⛔ Filed by the `domain:spec` seat; devs do not POST issues.

## The defect

`objectui#6741` is a **dead reference**. Measured with control legs on the identical endpoint and token:

| request | result |
|---|---|
| objectui `issues/6741` | **404** |
| objectui `pulls/6741` | **404** |
| objectui 6735 · 6738 · 6739 · 6742 · 6743 · 6745 · 6750 | **200** each |

⇒ the 404 is **the number**, ⛔ not the endpoint and ⛔ not the token. objectstack#6741 is an unrelated ADR-governance ruling; neither the CHANGELOG nor the #13446 commit body carries the reference.

PR #18608 removed it from `packages/spec/scripts/check-generated.ts` and `packages/spec/scripts/check-react-blocks-declaration-parity.ts`, and left a **number-free tombstone** in the parity header so nobody restores it. ⚠️ It survives at `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs:28` — **and that is the header both corrected sites now point readers to for the readings.** So a reader following the corrected trail lands on the one remaining dead number.

## Keep the fact, drop the number

The claim the citation supports — that plain-Node enumeration of the registry works — **is true and was reproduced independently**: an at-tier review npm-installed the 17 published `@object-ui@17.6.0` packages, bundled `sdui-parser`, ran the generator under plain Node, and got `sha256 49211fee7792` / `git hash-object 78f870e42fe9` / `cmp` byte-identical to the tracked artefact.

⇒ ⛔ Do not delete the statement. Either find the real reference and cite it, or state the fact without a number, matching the tombstone form #18608 already established in the sibling file.

## Fence

⚠️ This file is also the subject of an **open mechanism question** — #17735 carries a decision card (`5711529692`) on whether the node producer should point at the pin's built tree (M1), retire in favour of the browser dump (M2), or keep the skew with a detector (M3). If that ruling lands first, whoever executes it will be in this file anyway and should carry this fix. ⛔ But do not let this card wait silently on it: the citation is dead today regardless of which mechanism wins.

Dedupe words: `gen-sdui-manifest-node objectui#6741`, `dead citation 404 header`, `browser-only claim expired`, `plain Node enumeration citation`, `number-free tombstone sibling`.
